name: Create New Native Provider User
summary: Creates a new durable user for a validated provider subject only after duplicate checks and profile requirements pass.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and credential-proof == native-provider-proved and durable-identity == absent and profile-completeness == complete

setup: Ensure the provider subject has no durable identity link and canonical duplicate checks pass.

postconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and account-status == active and home-workspace == required and pending-identity-status == resolved
